requirements.title: Session Status and Controls
requirements.description: Drawer displays active session list with status indicators, workspace controls, and session management actions (rename, terminate).

validation.notes: Sidebar renders session rows, grouping, sorting, and its primary controls
Session time formatting for drawer display

requirements.title: Session Action Feedback

validation.notes: Session management exposes an explicit remove action per pane
Terminal context menu tests cover confirmation-backed destructive actions
